strategies_oos_50_50.note: A/B/C P&L identical when every logged bet is taken; compare EV buckets & probability metrics for signal.

conclusions.executive: Season 2 log: 1900 rows, 1755 settled. Baseline settled ROI=-0.0520 (-91.25u). OOS 50/50 ROI=-0.0607 (95% CI -0.1204–-0.0012). Raw probabilities are miscalibrated (ECE=0.096). Candidate strategy OOS ROI=-0.0333 on 18 bets.

qa.Is the raw model probability calibrated?: No — full-sample ECE/Brier and bin-level errors show systematic miscalibration (ECE≈0.096). High predicted bins often underperform implied win rates.
qa.Does calibration materially improve prob: OOS test-half metrics in JSON: raw Brier=0.2499, isotonic Brier=0.2399, Platt Brier=0.2395.
qa.Does calibrated EV predict realized ROI: Spearman(raw EV vs ROI)=-0.536, Spearman(calibrated EV vs ROI)=-0.250. Calibrated EV ordering aligns slightly better with realized ROI.
qa.Does higher calibrated EV correspond to: Weak / inconsistent — inspect calibrated EV bucket table; high reported EV buckets often underperform.
qa.Are the apparent league effects still pr: [{'league': 'Serie A', 'bets': 64, 'roi': 0.21078124999999998}, {'league': 'Eredivisie', 'bets': 51, 'roi': 0.19686274509803928}, {'league': 'Liga MX', 'bets': 34, 'roi': 0.1585294117647059}] (sufficient-N leagues only; see league OOS table in JSON).
qa.Does the proposed 1.90\u20132.50 / 3\u20: Candidate OOS ROI=-0.0333 on 18 bets vs baseline-all OOS ROI=-0.0607. Shows higher OOS ROI but verify N and CI.
qa.What is the estimated out-of-sample ROI: OOS 50/50 ROI point estimate -0.0607; bootstrap 95% CI [-0.1204, -0.0012] on all OOS bets.
qa.What evidence supports or contradicts pr: Full-sample win rate 56.1% vs avg break-even implied 59.2%; settled ROI -0.0520. OOS bootstrap 95% CI for ROI excludes zero (negative), contradicting positive edge at flat 1u. Calibration improves probability scores but does not flip aggregate OOS profitability.
qa.What should we change BEFORE live deploy: Deploy calibration layer trained walk-forward; re-evaluate filters using calibrated EV; do not tighten filters on full-sample bins; collect holdout season before production changes.
